offering_description.value: Provides retirement solutions and insurance products in the US. Sells annuities, retirement plan recordkeeping and services, life insurance and institutional investment products to individuals, employers and institutions through advisors, brokers and direct relationships.

primary_products.value: fixed annuities; variable annuities; index annuities; life insurance; stable value wrap and guaranteed investment contracts

primary_services.value: retirement plan recordkeeping and administration; asset management; investment advisory; pension risk transfer

customer_segment.value: B2C: individuals buying annuities and life insurance for retirement savings and protection; B2B: employers, retirement plan sponsors, pension plans, and institutional investors; B2G: public education and governmental retirement plans such as 403(b) and 457 plans

end_markets.value: retirement savings; life insurance; institutional investing; education and public-sector retirement plans

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: net investment income and premiums on annuities, life insurance and risk transfer contracts; service fees: policy fees, advisory and asset management fees, plan recordkeeping fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: underwrites annuities and life insurance, investing premiums, sells to individuals, plan sponsors and institutions; service provider: recordkeeping and advisory services for retirement plans and participants

geography_served.value: US national: United States, with operations across all states

specialization.value: related lines: individual retirement, group retirement, life insurance and institutional markets

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent agents, broker-dealers, banks and wholesalers selling annuities and life insurance; direct sales: retirement plan sales to employers and financial advisors serving plan participants; partners / resellers: third-party distribution partners and institutional relationships for institutional products
distribution_channels.category: agents / brokers; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance regulated by state insurance departments, SEC and FINRA for securities, DOL/ERISA for retirement plans
